info.title: Gains Trading API
info.description: Native REST and WebSocket API for trading on Gains Network. Resource-oriented, JSON in and out, decimal strings for every price and size, one EIP-712 signing scheme, and an order lifecycle that hides the oracle two-step.

post.description: Validates the order, checks the agent scope, simulates it from the agent and returns the transaction the agent signs and broadcasts (`transaction`) together with the order in `prepared` state and its final id. After broadcasting, `POST /orders/{id}/submit` with the hash; the order becomes `pending` (market) or `open` (limit, stop). The API also watches the chain, so a prepared order whose transaction lands moves on without the submit call.

201.description: The order, with its lifecycle id

post.summary: Report the broadcast transaction of a prepared order
post.description: Records the transaction hash the agent broadcast for a prepared order. When the receipt is already available the order moves to `pending` or `open` (and is re-keyed if the Diamond assigned another index); otherwise it stays `prepared` with the hash until the chain watcher sees it.

201.description: The close request, `pending` until the oracle fills it

patch.summary: Update stop loss, take profit, leverage or collateral

post.description: Registers the agent and its scope, signed by the trader's master wallet (EIP-712 `AgentAuthorization`). The response carries the `setTradingDelegate` transaction the master wallet must send; the agent becomes `active` once it is mined.

201.description: The agent and the transaction to send

delete.description: Disables the agent immediately in the API and returns the `removeTradingDelegate` transaction for the master wallet.

post.description: Signed by the master wallet (EIP-712 `ApiKeyIssue`). The key is returned once and never stored in clear.

Accepts the Hyperliquid `POST /info` request types (`meta`, `metaAndAssetCtxs`, `allMids`, `l2Book`, `candleSnapshot`, `clearinghouseState`, `openOrders`, `frontendOpenOrders`, `userFills`, `userFillsByTime`, `orderStatus`, `historicalOrders`, `userFunding`, `fundingHistory`, `userRateLimit`, `userFees`, `referral`, `spotMeta`, `spotClearinghouseState`, `subAccounts`, `vaultDetails`) and answers with Hyperliquid's shapes. Asset id `a` equals the Gains `pairIndex`.

200.description: Hyperliquid-shaped response, or `null` for an unknown coin

post.description: Accepts the Hyperliquid `POST /exchange` envelope `{action, nonce, signature, vaultAddress?, expiresAfter?}` with Hyperliquid's exact signing (msgpack action hash, phantom agent EIP-712 on chain id 1337; user-signed actions on the `HyperliquidSignTransaction` domain). The signing agent must be a Gains agent: one `approveAgent` plus one `setTradingDelegate` transaction by the master wallet. Custody actions (`usdSend`, `withdraw3`, `spotSend`, vaults, sub-accounts) return an `err` envelope: funds never leave the wallet.

200.description: `{status: "ok" | "err", response}`; order statuses add `{pending: {oid, txHash}}` for the oracle step
